question: A typist takes 40 minutes to type 2 pages. How many pages will he type in 80 minutes?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Work done is directly proportional to the time taken.

Time multiplier = 80 ÷ 40 = 2

Pages typed = 2 pages × 2 = 4 pages

**∴ The correct answer is 4 pages.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken to type 2 pages = 40 minutes

Total time given = 80 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Work₁ ÷ Time₁ = Work₂ ÷ Time₂

 
 40 minutes
 2 pages
 
 

 

 × 2
 
 
 80 minutes
 ? pages
 
 

 

 Directly Proportional

**Calculations:**

⇒ Pages typed in 40 minutes = 2

⇒ Pages typed in 1 minute = 2 ÷ 40 = 1/20

⇒ Pages typed in 80 minutes = (1/20) × 80

⇒ Pages typed in 80 minutes = 80 ÷ 20 = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4 pages.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportion

Two quantities are directly proportional if an increase in one results in a proportional increase in the other. Formula: x₁ ÷ y₁ = x₂ ÷ y₂

Inverse Proportion

Two quantities are inversely proportional if an increase in one results in a proportional decrease in the other. Formula: x₁ × y₁ = x₂ × y₂

Unitary Method

A mathematical technique where you first find the value of a single unit and then multiply it to find the value of any required number of units.
